entry.content:
Classic. It says it right there in the name. And with spartan use of Arabic numerals on its matte black dial, a black NATO strap, and a single lumen dot on the black aluminum bezel insert, the Unimatic UC3 Classic does qualify. Pale green Super-LumiNova C3 markings ensure legibility, which is necessary when taking advantage of the 40mm brushed stainless steel case's 300m water resistance. It's powered by a Seiko Meca-quartz movement, which runs the phantom ladder hour and minute hands as well as the sweeping lollipop second hand. Made in Italy, each watch is individually numbered.

entry.content:
Bell & Ross gives the BR-05 its first moon-phase display, with a black aventurine dial to represent space and a glow-in-the-dark moon engraved in a crystal that sits in a window at 6 o'clock. A black-and-white disc turns underneath to cast a shadow across the moon and show each of the eight phases. The 40 mm steel case has a steel bracelet, and the case-back is embossed with a full moon.

entry.content:
Minimal Company's second phone puts a real QWERTY keyboard back on the front of an Android. Its keys are polycarbonate and silicone, and each one is backlit. Above them, an AMOLED screen under sculpted glass replaces the first model's E Ink. Minimal OS blocks apps, quiets notifications and turns the display gray when you want to scroll less. The aluminum body is carved out of one block and comes in Pearl or Onyx, with 256 or 512 gigabytes of storage.
